title: Solomon's Administration

questions.question: How long did it take Solomon to build the house of the LORD and his own house?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:1 (ESV): "At the end of twenty years, in which Solomon had built the house of the LORD and his own house..."

questions.question: What did Solomon do with the cities Hiram gave him?
options: He rebuilt them and settled the people of Israel in them
questions.correctAnswer: He rebuilt them and settled the people of Israel in them
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:2 (ESV): "Solomon rebuilt the cities that Hiram had given to him..."

questions.question: Who where the people Solomon conscripted for forced labor?
options: The Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.correctAnswer: The Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:7 (ESV): "All the people who were left of the Hittites..."

questions.question: Did Solomon make slaves of the people of Israel?
options: No, they were soldiers, officers, and commanders
questions.correctAnswer: No, they were soldiers, officers, and commanders
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:9 (ESV): "But of the people of Israel Solomon made no slaves for his work; they were soldiers..."

questions.question: Where did Solomon move Pharaoh's daughter?
options: To the house that he had built for her
questions.correctAnswer: To the house that he had built for her
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:11 (ESV): "Solomon brought Pharaoh's daughter up from the city of David to the house that he had built for her..."

questions.question: Why did Solomon move his wife out of the city of David?
options: Because the places to which the ark of the LORD has come are holy
questions.correctAnswer: Because the places to which the ark of the LORD has come are holy
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:11 (ESV): "...for he said, 'My wife shall not live in the house of David... for the places to which the ark of the LORD has come are holy.'"

questions.question: How often did Solomon offer burnt offerings?
options: As the duty of each day required
questions.correctAnswer: As the duty of each day required
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:13 (ESV): "...as the duty of each day required..."

questions.question: Which feasts are specifically mentioned?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:13 (ESV): "...the three annual feasts—the Feast of Unleavened Bread, the Feast of Weeks, and the Feast of Booths."

questions.question: According to whose ordinance did he appoint the divisions of the priests?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:14 (ESV): "According to the ruling of David his father, he appointed the divisions of the priests..."

questions.question: Where did Solomon go to Ezion-geber?
options: At the seaside in the land of Edom
questions.correctAnswer: At the seaside in the land of Edom
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:17 (ESV): "Then Solomon went to Ezion-geber and Eloth on the shore of the sea, in the land of Edom."

questions.question: How much gold did they take from Ophir?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:18 (ESV): "...and they took from there 450 talents of gold..."

questions.question: Which city did Solomon build in the wilderness?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:4 (ESV): "He built Tadmor in the wilderness..."

questions.question: What specifically did Solomon build in Hamath?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:4 (ESV): "...and all the store cities that he built in Hamath."

questions.question: Who helped Solomon's servants with the ships?
options: Servants of Hiram who knew the sea
questions.correctAnswer: Servants of Hiram who knew the sea
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:18 (ESV): "And Hiram sent... servants who knew the sea, and they went with Solomon's servants..."

questions.question: Which Beth-horon did he build?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 8:5 (ESV): "He built Upper Beth-horon and Lower Beth-horon..."

key_verse_text: Thus was all the work of Solomon accomplished from the day the foundation of the house of the LORD was laid until it was finished. So the house of the LORD was completed.
